name: Pokémon Crystal
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. No boss team differences vs Gold/Silver were found. Bulbapedia lists every one of these bosses under a combined 'Pokemon Gold, Silver, and Crystal' party section, and Crystal-specific sources - the GameFAQs Crystal walkthrough trainer lists (Elite Four/Lance and the full trainer list entry for Red), the Prima Crystal strategy guide, and Guide Strats' per-gym Crystal pages (Whitney, Morty, Chuck, Pryce, Clair) - give identical species and levels for all 22 bosses, so the Gold/Silver teams are repeated verbatim. Crystal's actual changes are elsewhere: the Suicune/Eusine storyline, the Battle Tower, the Dragon's Den quiz required before Clair awards the Rising Badge, and some non-boss trainer parties and wild distributions - none of which affect boss rosters. Moves, abilities, and items intentionally left empty/null per pack spec.
